reportFamilies.label: Orders and products
reportFamilies.question: Which actual products and variants produce confirmed orders and fulfilment outcomes?
possibleMetrics: Orders completed by declared fulfilment outcome
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: An order cohort is distinct from line-item or unit counts. Do not combine item units, kg and packs.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Stock exception reports require actual stock evidence; product purchase does not create appointment metrics.

reportFamilies.label: Appointments
reportFamilies.question: Which appointment services are requested, confirmed, attended and completed?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Usable provider minutes must exclude closures, breaks and unavailable resources; reserved and actual-used minutes stay separate.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Scheduled bookings must actually be enabled. Walk-in-only and remote variants retain their actual workflow and resource rules.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: one appointment or explicit group size

reportFamilies.label: Field visits
reportFamilies.question: Where do feasible accepted visits progress and where do operational delays occur?
possibleMetrics: Recorded arrivals within accepted arrival window
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Arrival timeliness uses accepted windows and actual arrival evidence, not record creation timestamps.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Travel, access and eligible-team evidence are required; enabling home service alone does not create visits.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: team time and declared service workload

reportFamilies.label: Asset rentals
reportFamilies.question: Which assets are reserved or actually used against usable time?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Identified usable asset time excludes maintenance, closure and turnaround. Use one explicit hour or day convention.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Actual usage needs actual handover and return evidence. With-driver rentals remain rentals and require both resource guarantees.

reportFamilies.label: Transfers and greetings
reportFamilies.question: Which accepted trips or greeting services meet their actual pickup or meeting commitments?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Trip and greeter-only service counts remain labelled separately. Timeliness uses accepted pickup/meeting windows.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Greeter-only execution must not inherit vehicle travel or ride-completion assumptions.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: trip resource time and permitted passenger/luggage capacity

reportFamilies.label: Sessions and places
reportFamilies.question: How many places were reserved and attended for each actual occurrence?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Reserved or attended places divided by actual sellable occurrence places; holds, disabled places and walk-ins follow one capacity owner.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: A reservation count is not an attendee count. Place class constraints and actual attendance evidence must exist.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: places per actual occurrence and ticket class constraints

reportFamilies.label: Spaces and tables
reportFamilies.question: How do compatible tables or spaces serve actual parties across usable intervals?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Use compatible usable space minutes or a separately defined seat-minute measure. Party count, guest count and space occupancy differ.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Existing external reservation software is discovery only; reporting needs actual space/reservation authority and instrumented evidence.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: party size and exclusive space interval

reportFamilies.label: Tours and departures
reportFamilies.question: Which departure places or private tour commitments progress to actual completion?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Shared departure places and private tour intervals are separate measures; supplier-pending inventory is not confirmed capacity.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Tour variants preserve supplier scope and joint resource guarantees. Enquiry does not imply a booking.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: places per departure plus explicit private intervals

reportFamilies.label: Made-to-order production
reportFamilies.question: Which accepted production commitments reach their promised handoff?
possibleMetrics: Commitments handed off by accepted due date
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Timeliness uses the accepted promise and actual handoff. Production units and accepted commitments remain separate.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Unknown workload or specification cannot create a capacity or on-time claim. Scope changes retain accepted versions.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: declared production units and due windows

reportFamilies.label: Enquiries and quotes
reportFamilies.question: Where do submitted requests progress through response, quote and customer acceptance?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Quote-decision acceptance divides accepted eligible quote identities by eligible quote identities in a defined quote-issued cohort, with a stated decision deadline and revision rule. Requests with accepted quote divides distinct eligible request identities that reached an accepted quote by eligible request identities in a defined request cohort, with a stated observation cutoff. These are separate rates with separate denominators. An accepted quote is distinct from paid or completed work.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Regulated enquiry keeps its administrative review graph; provider approval, loan approval, insurance outcome or investment performance must not be inferred.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: none for request; selected model units at commitment

reportFamilies.label: Collection, processing and return
reportFamilies.question: Can each linked collection, processing and return promise be traced to actual outcomes?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Collection leg, processing leg and return leg are separate counts; only one parent job contributes to end-to-end completion.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Firm return promises need confirmed linked capacity. Dispatch evidence cannot invent initial feasibility or final handoff.

reportFamilies.label: Service and repair jobs
reportFamilies.question: Which assessed and approved jobs finish their accepted scope and handoff?
possibleMetrics: Jobs handed off by accepted promise
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Assessment, approval, execution and handoff times use their own source events; open jobs are censored rather than zero-duration.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: A repair job is not automatically a blocking appointment. A linked intake appointment has its own identity and measure.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: job workload or explicit resource interval

reportFamilies.label: Plans and access
reportFamilies.question: How do valid plans and explicit credits translate into permitted access or actual session usage?
possibleMetrics: Active entitlements at an explicit date
Credits granted and consumed by unit
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Snapshot active entitlements, period enrolments, credits and actual booked places are separate measures.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Recurring orders or schedules do not create a membership. Renewal and payment consent need their actual owner records.
reportFamilies.sourceCapacityUnit: declared access/visit credit, distinct from places

reportFamilies.label: Freight and shipments
reportFamilies.question: Which accepted shipments meet their evidence-backed milestones and handoffs?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Shipment count, leg count, weight and volume use separate units. Promised milestones require actual accepted commitment records.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Carrier evidence and cargo/capacity scope must exist. A generic status update does not prove goods movement or customer handoff.

reportFamilies.label: Storage and custody
reportFamilies.question: Which accepted storage allocations occupy compatible usable capacity through actual exit?
reportFamilies.denominatorAndUnitPolicy: Compatible usable unit-days, area-days or volume-days must use matching precision and units; do not mix them.
reportFamilies.evidenceGate: Capacity and custody require typed accepted goods/quantity evidence. A scheduled exit does not prove actual vacancy.
